nodes.description: mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; token balance ledger written by transferFrom and batchSend.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spender approvals mutated in approve and transferFrom.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter used by condition().
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; whitelist bypass checked in ensure().
uint256 private _minSale; minimum transfer amount enforced in condition().
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum transfer amount enforced in condition().
uint256 private _saleNum; global sale limit used in condition().
address tradeAddress; privileged address whitelisted inside ensure(), set by setTradeAddress().
address private owner; privileged account checked by every administrative function.
uint public totalSupply; set once in the constructor using unchecked multiplication.
string public name; token name assigned in the constructor.
string public symbol; token symbol assigned in the constructor.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist check that falls through to condition().
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; mutates allowance, balances and _onSaleNum with raw arithmetic.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits.
batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass distribution with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only update of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; deterministic Uniswap pair address computation.
constructor(string _name, string _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; mints supply and grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Parameter _to of transfer() is forwarded to transferFrom as the recipient.
Parameter _value of transfer() determines the amount moved.
msg.sender is used as the _from account of the transfer.
Parameter _from of transferFrom() selects the debited account and is checked against the allowance.
Parameter _to of transferFrom() selects the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom() controls the amount transferred and the allowance decrement.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance path is taken (msg.sender != _from) and whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
transferFrom() reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom() reads and writes sender and recipient balances.
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value is performed with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is performed with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is performed with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
Parameter _from of ensure() drives the whitelist and condition checks.
Parameter _to of ensure() is compared against owner and tradeAddress whitelists.
Parameter _value of ensure() is forwarded to condition() for limit checks.
ensure() bypasses all sale restrictions when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure() returns true without restriction when canSale[_from] is set, a privileged whitelist.
ensure() compares _from against tradeAddress, a privileged bypass address.
ensure() calls condition(_from, _value) as the only non-whitelisted path.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] with _saleNum.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide whether the per-address cap applies.
condition() rejects transfers below _minSale.
condition() rejects transfers above _maxSale.
The _from value validated by ensure() is passed into condition().
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner), a single point of privileged control.
Parameter a of delegate() is the arbitrary target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate() is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the target.
delegate() performs a.delegatecall(b), an external callback executing arbitrary code in this contract's storage context.
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
Parameter saleNum of init() becomes the global _saleNum limit.
Parameter token of init() is multiplied by 10**decimals to compute _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init() is multiplied by 10**decimals to compute _maxSale.
init() writes the _minSale configuration value.
init() writes the _maxSale configuration value.
init() writes the global _saleNum configuration value.
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
Parameter _tos of batchSend() determines the recipient list and the loop length.
Parameter _value of batchSend() determines the amount credited to every recipient.
batchSend() computes the local total deducted from the sender.
batchSend() maintains the loop counter i.
batchSend() assigns each recipient to the loop-local address _to.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend() subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] with raw arithmetic.
batchSend() credits each recipient balance in the balanceOf mapping.
Elements of the _tos array are copied into the loop-local _to address.
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress() becomes the new whitelisted tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() writes the tradeAddress state variable used in ensure().
Parameter _spender of approve() is the approval beneficiary.
Parameter _value of approve() is the approval amount granted.
approve() sets the allowance for msg.sender as the token owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Constructor parameter _name initializes the name state variable.
Constructor parameter _symbol initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor parameter _supply is multiplied by 10**decimals with unchecked arithmetic to set totalSupply.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the entire minted supply.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the scaled _supply value.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the entire supply.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address.
